title: BRAF V600E Mutations In Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether BRAF V600E mutation in our patients with papillary thyroid cancer has an association with poor prognosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with papillary thyroid cancer

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who do not want to be a part of this study
